parsed.explanation: Documented tier-1/2 exposures to a trans visitor: penal provisions cited as criminalising gender expression (vagrancy/'personation'), police named the foremost abuser of LGBTI people — harassment, arbitrary detention, extortion under threat of arrest, and refusal of complaints from LGBTQ victims, acknowledged by police and the rights commission themselves, with no anti-discrimination protection and no working remedy. Custody is birth-sex by default with no trans housing; the ID-gated preference route depends on a domestic certificate a visitor cannot hold, leaving medicalised discretion — a universal exposure for anyone detained — and forced anal/vaginal exams are documented. Counterweights: prosecutions limited, no documented trans-specific violence rate, legal-recognition circular, mixed-to-positive official and public posture. Below Orenna/Nivaro (0.35) because the police-protection gap and custody rule compound, but above 0.25 dossiers lacking acknowledged systematic abuse and an explicit gender-expression statute.
